title.narrative: Signature of ANNEX II EXCERPT RULES GOVERNING THE USE OF EP PREMISES BY OUTSIDE BODIES & Interpretation invoice for the Organisation of the Brussels VII Conference on ''Supporting the Future of Syria and the Region'' on 14 June 2023

description.narrative:
The organisation of this conference is of the highest political importance involving the participation of high-level political representatives, including Heads of State and Government, 2 Commissioners and the HRVP. Traditionally, previous editions of the Brussels Conference for Syria and the future of its region have been hosted by the European Parliament and organised in the Hemicylce of the Paul Henri Spaak building (used by MEPs during Brussels plenary sessions). The European Parliament will provide for the necessary logistical and secure connection arrangements, needed for the organisation of this global conference. As such, the European Parliament has the required resources in terms of technical knowhow and manpower to ensure the smooth running of this high-level event.

The European Parliament has the ideal venue for the Day of Dialogue event as it is the only building capable of accommodating the number of representatives who will be invited, including the necessary protocol services and necessary security requirements. In addition, the Brussels Conferences have been historically linked to the HEM cycle as the 2019 Brussels III Conference also took place there.

The Secretary-General and his administration have exclusive rights to this building and is the only possible contracting counterpart. It is therefore necessary to use sign the Annex II and separate interpretation invoicing documents rather than a standard service contract. The combined sum of Annex II (EUR 18.003 00), covering the use of meeting rooms with accompanying services (as stated in Annex I) and the interpretation costs (EUR 15.876,00), invoiced separately, amount to EUR 33.879,00 overall.

In addition to these costs, the costs of the Day of Dialogue for catering and web streaming are invoiced through the Conference¿s PMO, contracted via the DG SCIC Specific Contract FWC/PCO/Lot3-23/001, Ares(2023)3026997. The Ministerial event is covered by a service-level agreement signed with the General-Secretariat of the Council, Ares(2023)4657488.

The billing procedure will be launched after the event will be finalized based on the real use of the facilities, payable upon receipt of the invoice. Please note that the use of the facilities for setting-up and dismantling will be billed.
